finalBehavior.nativeActions: Long press/right click the List in the sidebar context menu.
finalBehavior.listCatalog: Active by default; Archived or All reveals archived List identities.
finalBehavior.preservation: Tokyo retains Zulu then Alpha, the same membership identities and 1/2 progress; Wishlist Zulu and global Zulu remain Todo and the source remains active.
finalBehavior.relaunch: Archive persists; catalog visibility resets to Active; Unarchive preserves order and local completion.
finalBehavior.coreChange: No PlannerCore changes from the base commit.

historicalCorrections: Initial red reaches the missing content-toolbar List actions control.
First iPhone green fails because its test queries the global Toggle as a Button. The query is corrected to the existing native accessibility boundary.
First iPad green cannot reach New List because the long sidebar filter label overflows. The visible label is shortened while retaining the full accessibility label.
Compact iPhone passes. Compact iPad finds that the new content-toolbar List actions control displaces Add Item.
The final UI uses the sidebar context menu and removes the redundant content-toolbar action. Both final archive journeys pass.

findings: Archive status and the unchanged 1/2 ProgressView appear with Zulu then Alpha.
All Lists includes archived Tokyo with an archive icon and active Wishlist.
After relaunch and Unarchive the two memberships, order and completion remain intact.
The iPad sidebar title truncates at this width; the archive header uses subdued secondary text. Resizing and contrast/human review remain open in the native polish gate.
